'''Semo''', also called '''semolina fufu''', is a Nigerian [[Cookbook:Swallow|swallow]] eaten with various soups, such as [[Cookbook:Egusi Soup|egusi soup]], okro soup, efọ̀ riro, and Nigerian èfirin soup. It is nutritious and starchy.

== Ingredients ==
*[[Cookbook:Water|Water]]
*[[Cookbook:Semolina|Semolina]] flour

==Equipment==
*Cooking pot
*Wooden spatula or strong cooking spoon
*Measuring cup
*Bowl

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] water in a pot.
#Gradually mix the semolina flour into the boiling water, stirring with a [[Cookbook:Spatula|spatula]] until it forms a smooth and lump-free [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]]. Stop adding semolina flour when you can no longer stir easily.
#Stir the semolina mixture vigorously to eliminate any lumps.
#Once you have a smooth mixture, add a small amount of water to bring it to the desired consistency. Cover the pot, and cook for about 3 minutes.
#Serve with your soup of choice.

Stir the semolina mixture vigorously to eliminate any lumps.
Once you have a smooth mixture, add a small amount of water to bring it to the desired consistency. Cover the pot, and cook for about 3 minutes.
